parts:
Hi,

I have data.frame with R Dates in one column and corresponding numeric values in another. When I plot it with ggvis using Date column as x-axis variable, ggvis only shows some numbers on the x-axis. 

As I guess, ggvis does not convert the Date column to javascript date objects. What can I do about this?

best regards,
erhan
